messages:
sarah: Quick q — planning to roll inference-newcache to a 25% canary tonight at 22:00 PT. Who is authorized to flip the kill switch if we see latency spikes or error regressions? Also need to confirm escalation path and what gets recorded for audits.

raj: SRE oncall (me) can flip. For production emergency toggles we require primary oncall + platform lead ack. Follow the 'emergency-toggle' playbook. Prefer to move canary -> 0% rather than a full rollback when possible.

emily: Agree with raj. Two operational points: (1) any manual toggle must open an incident channel before the flip unless it9s an immediate safety kill, (2) the flag service auto-writes an audit event. Runbook snippet below.

emily: ```
# Disable via CLI (example)
rflag set --env=prod --flag=inference-newcache --value=off --actor=raj --reason="latency spike - job 778"
# Writes to flag-audit-prod index and emits to kinesis/ops-stream
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled rollout: inference-newcache -> 25% at 2025-07-08 22:00 PT (job 778).

mike: Quick Q: for a 25% canary, what are the circuit-breaker thresholds we should watch? P95 latency, errors?

raj: Runbook thresholds for this model: P95 > 1500ms OR error rate > 0.8% triggers manual disable. For other less latency-sensitive flows we use 2000ms and 1%. Documented in the kb.

sarah: Two follow-ups — (1) who has console UI access to flip flags (role names), (2) how do we prove the flip happened for compliance?

emily: Console flips require the platform-admin role. Audit proof: every change emits an audit event with actor, flag, old_value, new_value, reason, timestamp, correlation_id. Events are indexed in flag-audit-prod; we can export CSVs on request. Also we tag the incident channel with the correlation_id.

jordan: For oncall backup: if primary oncall is unreachable, secondary + a platform pager duty responder can perform the flip. Add a post-incident action to review the affected prompt set and metrics.

sarah: :thumbsup: I9ll update the runbook with the exact CLI snippet and add a checkbox to create the incident channel before flipping unless it9s immediate.

raj: Small ops ask: require that the audit reason always contains the deployment id/job id (e.g., "latency spike - job 778") so we can correlate trace ids.

emily: Done — I9ll push the runbook change and add a quick link from the console to the audit index. tagging @sarah @raj for verification.

sarah: Thanks everyone — I9ll send a short announcement to #all-hands with the safety steps and link to the updated runbook after verification.
